span.p:
Typical positioning: Prioritize
availability and accuracy, accept
eventual consistency for cost views.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Budget availability is critical:
the system must always know
whether a request can be processed.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p: Cost accuracy is important: teams need accurate chargeback.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Cost consistency is secondary: a
60-second delay between a request
in Tokyo and a dashboard update in
Virginia is acceptable for
reporting purposes.
